repairs.quote: Passive: Nocturne gains 30/35/40/45/50% Attack Speed. Active: Nocturne creates a shadow barrier for 1.5 seconds that blocks the next enemy Ability. If an Ability is blocked, this Ability's passive effect is increased to 60/70/80/90/100% Attack Speed for 5 seconds. This Ability will remain active during Paranoia's flight.
